summary: Woodward, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a Third Amended and Restated Credit Agreement on May 28, 2026. The agreement provides a $1,000,000,000 revolving credit facility, extending the termination date to May 28, 2031. The company borrowed $413 million to repay prior obligations and fees. Interest rates are based on adjusted term SOFR (or equivalents for other currencies) plus a spread of 0.875% to 1.75%. This is a routine refinancing of existing credit facilities with customary covenants, not a special situation.
